style.checked_requirement: Cinematic photographic riverside screening and conversation at left; crisp pale full-height editorial notice at right; approachable adult neighborhood tone
style.observed: Concrete bridge, fabric screen, water reflections, winter-jacket adult neighbors and motivated screen/amber lighting coexist with high-contrast dark notice lettering.

substantive_visual.observed: Bridge shelter, river/path, supported cinema screen, six adults on separate mats, and one microphone-holding speaker identify outdoor screening and conversation; the scene is substantive.

hangul.observed: Consistent proportions, visible internal counters and word spaces; no specific malformed or missing syllable observed at native/usage720.

information_relationship.observed: Title and luminous screen at left lead into right schedule, participation, then preparation/contingency. All facts have protected pale-background contrast.

function_contact.observed: Microphone belongs to one speaker hand/forearm; two screen supports contact the path; each seated adult occupies a distinct mat.

material_edge_finish.observed: Natural concrete, fabric and water details; coherent warm bridge and white screen light; clean photo/notice edge and crisp text.

located_observations.location: left scene, central screen and lower foreground
located_observations.observation: A supported luminous screen displays a landscape still; six adults face it from individual mats, and the bridge underside and riverside water establish an outdoor screening.

located_observations.location: right edge of photographic scene beside screen
located_observations.observation: One standing speaker holds one visible handheld microphone near the mouth; the gripping hand connects to a bent forearm and jacket sleeve. No extra microphone is visible.

located_observations.location: screen lower corners and audience contact
located_observations.observation: Two black screen upright supports extend to feet on the path; mats rest flat with fabric edges and shadows under the seated figures.
Date, time and venue occupy the upper group, entry and free/capacity occupy the middle group, and mat/rain instructions occupy the lower group. Every line is readable with dark type on a pale field.
Korean title, uppercase English line and event descriptor are each read once. White lettering remains distinct from sky and dark bridge underside.
Hangul has consistent squared proportions, open internal counters and visible word gaps; no specific malformed or missing syllable was observed.

located_observations.location: time, entry time, descriptor and admission punctuation
located_observations.observation: Both colons show two dots, the time range shows an elongated horizontal dash, and the descriptor/admission separators are visually middle dots. Raster reading does not authenticate encoded Unicode.
Luminous screen and large left title identify the gathering, while the pale vertical notice remains a strong second destination. No bottom information strip or alternate poster appears.

Warm bridge lights and white screen illumination produce coherent concrete, cloth and water highlights. The hard vertical scene/notice edge is clean and prevents photographic glare from entering the facts.

residuals.location: end of Korean title above bridge underside
residuals.observation: The final title word overlaps the dark underside of the bridge rather than a sky-only clearing; white contrast remains readable.
The seated adult nearest the notice is partially cut by the photographic boundary; this crop preserves the notice width.

residuals.location: speaker hand and small screen clamps
residuals.observation: At the usage view, the microphone grip and support clamps are small; their finer anatomical/mechanical details were inspected in the native view.

selection_reason: No observed literal-copy defect or usage720 unreadability warrants a repair. Initial retains the assigned immersive scene and vertical facts.
